reading: The sketch lays out a dashboard page: a dark navy sidebar nav on the left, a page heading and filter buttons at top, a large heatmap card and a peak-hour stat card side by side, and a data table below. Typed notes supply the exact labels, nav items, button states, heatmap data and table contents.
